item.title: Week on Wall Street delivers a bumpy ride
item.description: The week on Wall Street delivered a bumpy ride for investors, with swings in both directions as traders weighed corporate earnings against shifting expectations for central bank policy. Markets closed mixed on Friday after a late-afternoon slip in technology shares erased earlier gains. Economists surveyed by the central bank say the outlook remains broadly stable, though they warned that persistent price pressures in the housing sector could complicate decisions in the coming months. Analysts now expect the next rate decision to be a close call, with futures markets pricing in a roughly even split between a cut and a hold.
